ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-J in the area bounded by
Public Alley west of and parallel to North Central Park Avenue; West
Thomas Street; North Central Park Avenue; and a line 73.70 feet south of
and parallel to West Thomas Street;
to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District is

hereby established in the area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

* ‘due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1052-58 N. Central Park Avenue
